{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bz''' was a unit of measurement that measured the amount of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] data a [[Mem-stik/Legends|mem-stik]] could hold. A [[HiBaka 2000 mem-stik]] could hold 14 Bz of data.
